description:
We are looking for an experienced \*Sterling OMS Java Developer\* to design, develop, customize, and support enterprise order management solutions.
 



  





 \#\# Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Develop and customize solutions using \*IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS)\*.
 



 \* Build Java\-based extensions, APIs, services, and integrations.
 



 \* Work on order management, inventory, sourcing, fulfillment, shipping, and returns workflows.
 



 \* Integrate Sterling OMS with e\-commerce, warehouse, ERP, payment, and other enterprise systems.
 



 \* Troubleshoot application issues and improve system performance.
 



 \* Collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver scalable solutions.
 



  





 \#\# Required Skills
 



  





 \* Strong experience with \*IBM Sterling OMS\*.
 



 \* Strong development experience in \*Java/J2EE\*.
 



 \* Experience with \*REST/SOAP APIs, XML, JSON, and SQL\*.
 



 \* Understanding of \*Order Management, Inventory, Fulfillment, and Supply Chain\* processes.
 



 \* Experience with enterprise integrations and distributed applications.
 



 \* Knowledge of \*Spring/Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka or MQ\* is preferred.
 



  





 \#\# Experience
 



  





 \*5\+ years of software development experience with hands\-on Sterling OMS and Java development experience.\*
